sense: surroundings: the place and conditions one lives or works in

evidence: Tac. Ann. 1.21: vagī circumjecta populābantur (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: the neighbourhood (sc. loca); Traupman’s word for one’s environment. For the natural world, “the environment”, see nature, the natural world.
A nineteenth-century coinage from ambiō, “go round”; Morgan–Owens also gives rēs circumdatae.

sources: Lewis & Short: circumicio · Lewis & Short: ambio
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: environment, surroundings.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 310, checked against the searchable text of the book (9 November 2026).
